## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 340 image captures during April 2022. The activity report indicates that sessions proceeded as planned, apart from routine leave. The recorded capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. No other activity has been included in this summary.

## Image quality

Of the 340 captures, 23 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.8 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that produced a grading outcome. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for April 2022.

## Grading

There were 63 referable results during the reporting period. The median grading lag was 21 days. This is the median time between image capture and completion of grading, and provides an indication of the usual reporting interval. Together, the referable results and grading lag summarise the grading position for West Gate Eye Clinic in April 2022.
